rows.why: S1 is mostly about the header row. Item 1 asks for the columns, their order and their labels, and its run gives exactly 'Requisition ID,Title,Status,Openings,Filled,Created'. Items 4 (BOM), 2 (row order) and 5 (CRLF) cover the rest of S1, and their runs agree too.

S2 starts with how status is written, which is item 9's question. The scenario wants 'On hold', but the run writes the raw 'on_hold'. Item 8 (date format) doesn't match either: it writes the full ISO timestamp, not YYYY-MM-DD.
Item 3 asks what an empty list produces. Its run returns the BOM plus the header row and CRLF, nothing else, which is what S3 expects.
Item 6 asks when a cell gets quoted. It quotes only on comma, quote, CR or LF. In its run the title ' pad ' (leading and trailing space) comes out unquoted, but S4 requires quotes.
No item asks whether a title starting like a formula (=, +, -, @, tab, CR) gets a leading single quote. Item 6 covers only CSV quoting and escaping, which is a different behaviour.
Item 10 asks what happens on an unknown status, bad counts, filled > openings or an invalid date. It throws an Error that names the id ('Requisition bad1: unknown status "weird"'), as S6 expects.
